question: Does re-picking a rating's settings each season beat keeping them fixed?
answer: It passes in CS2, NHL, CBB, and fails in Tennis, Soccer, NFL, NBA.
findings: CS2: -1.56 log loss ×1000, t by month -3.49, 13/16 months.
NHL: -0.65 log loss ×1000, t by month -2.85, 18/27 months.
CBB: -0.65 log loss ×1000, t by month -2.52, 27/36 months.
Tennis: -0.09 log loss ×1000, t by month -1.19, 26/46 months.
method: Each season (each month in CS2), the settings with the lowest walk-forward log loss on every earlier season are picked from the shipped set and from one-step moves on each tuned setting. They are then scored once on that season against the shipped settings. Only held-out seasons count, and a sport passes at t by month <= -2.
data: Each sport's game-model history, on held-out seasons before the 2026-27 lockbox. CS2 runs from Jul 2025 to its last sealed month.
